story_sequence.text: `docs/beacon/governance/version-truth-catalog.md` is the sole commit source for version-level truth placement; `parser_contract: beacon-version-truth-catalog-v1`; frontmatter carries `transaction_id`, `source_hash`, `active_delivery_window`.
Catalog lists exactly **3** `validation_state: active` versions; their `truth_root` values are `docs/beacon/<version>/` only.

Archived versions have `truth_root` under `docs/beacon/archive/<version>/`; `catalog apply` / `bootstrap --confirm` **moves** trees (relocate, not delete); bounded internal link rewrite per closure C3.

`beacon doctor verify-version-truth-catalog --strict` fails closed on MD ↔ `.machine/version-truth-catalog.json` mismatch, missing sqlite `source_hash` row (when shared store used), or on-disk path ≠ catalog `truth_root`.

Default delivery commands (`implement`, `qa`, `release`, truth-map bulk scans) resolve roots from catalog **active** set only; explicit `--version` may target archived roots for inspect-only surfaces; non-active delivery without `--include-archived` fails closed.
Unified `discover_features(version)` lists `features/*/truth.md` on v1.5.2+ (not `prd/` only); used by archive plan/status and truth-map inventory.
`beacon archive lineage <slug> [--from v] [--to v]` returns ordered hops with `truth_path`, optional `change_path`, freeze revision / source_hash across active + archive roots.
`beacon archive inventory [--version auto]` builds feature × AC matrix from active versions' `truth.md` AC tables; archived omitted unless `--include-archived`.
`docs/beacon/archive/INDEX.md` is regenerated on every `catalog apply` / `bootstrap --confirm`; not hand-edited; lists active set, archived count, feature counts, quick commands.

`beacon archive catalog bootstrap --active v1.5.0,v1.5.1,v1.5.2 --dry-run` previews ~46 relocations; `--confirm` performs one atomic transaction: write catalog MD + mv trees + INDEX + projections + strict verify.

`beacon-archive` skill documents decision boundary, four operator verbs, and scenario examples A–F (cutover, historical audit, cross-version evolution, capability map, feature retire, learnable archive).
Merge global-boundaries **§4.1 MD-only catalog and archive plane** and §1 support-surface clarification for archive vs change; drift on active plane blocks freeze/qa/release per §4.
